items.text:
別去Sepang看F1的四大理由

劝退！F1 重返雪邦？
听我一句劝，千万别去送人头！別去！

家里冷气开 16 度不香吗？非要跑去雪邦当“炭烤肉排”？

第一，现场看个寂寞。赛车“唰”一声飞过去，谁是谁你根本看不清！没有实时画面，大屏幕你也未必能看清，最后你还不是要在现场掏手机看直播？

第二，妆容灾难现场。想扮美美去拍照？Soli 啦，两分钟直接汗流浃背，随时再给你来场大暴雨，秒变落汤鸡！

第三，受虐式徒步。Parking贵的要死，还要在无遮盖的烈日下走几公里，还没坐下就已经半条命。

第四，砍菜头物价。禁止自带水，里面一杯毫无冰块的常温汽水卖天价！再加上震到头晕耳鸣的噪音，简直是花钱买罪受。

乖，把买门票的钱省下来吃大餐，躺在家里的沙发看，真的比較舒服。

让我去受罪就好了

Who has always dreamed of studying in Oxford, Cambridge, or Edinburgh? 🇬🇧

The UK Future Leader Program 2027 is now officially open for applications! This is a one week international learning program for students, young professionals, and emerging leaders aged 18 to 45, who want more than just a trip abroad. You will study English alongside international students, stay with a local host family, and explore Oxford, Cambridge, or Edinburgh, three of the most iconic learning cities in the world.

It is a real learning experience, built around communication, leadership, and personal growth, in an environment that genuinely pushes you forward.

Here is what you will get from the program:
✔️ Homestay accommodation with a local UK family (breakfast & dinner included)
✔️ English & communication classes with international students
✔️ College visits & city explorations
✔️ Public speaking & leadership sessions
✔️ Real intercultural experience & international network
✔️ Official certificate of participation
✔️ Travel insurance included

Choose your pathway:
📍 Oxford — 21 to 27 March 2027

Harga runcit petrol RON97, RON95 tanpa subsidi dan diesel tanpa subsidi masing-masing meningkat 20 sen seliter bagi tempoh 30 Julai hingga 5 Ogos ini.

Kementerian Kewangan (MOF) memaklumkan harga baharu RON97 ditetapkan pada RM4.40 seliter, RON95 tanpa subsidi RM3.82 seliter dan diesel tanpa subsidi RM4.62 seliter, berkuat kuasa mulai Khamis.

Menurut MOF, harga produk petroleum tanpa subsidi dipengaruhi pergerakan pasaran minyak dunia pada minggu terdahulu, dengan konflik berterusan antara Amerika Syarikat dan Iran mendorong harga minyak mentah Brent meningkat ke paras tertinggi dalam tempoh enam minggu, iaitu USD96 setong.

Lanjut: https://www.astroawani.com/berita-malaysia/harga-ron97-ron95-dan-diesel-tanpa-subsidi-naik-20-sen-seliter
